pattern: HEAD ye (ta | ARG) [pa | la] [no] (si | ama) (ARG | ta) ya bi na doma.
binding: Exactly one ta in the relative clause refers to the immediately preceding head. Other third-person reference requires a separate sentence in this pilot.
notice: The parser verifies this bounded profile only. ye/ya and soma/dani remain candidate lexemes; no core promotion. Unmarked tense is unspecified, not necessarily present.
